verdict.rationale: Stripe Checkout explicitly offers a Stripe-hosted redirect page (stripe-docs-2) with prebuilt UI via Checkout Sessions API (stripe-docs-50), supporting 125+ local payment methods (stripe-docs-3) and no-code Payment Links as an even simpler hosted option (stripe-docs-4, stripe-docs-36). This directly matches the story of redirecting to a vendor-hosted, conversion-optimized page without building custom payment UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence specifically validating conversion optimization claims or real-world developer testimonials about the hosted checkout flow itself.
